description:
From the fz-kdt.183 research (2026-09-03, d2a5f3510). jobs/semantic.rs
merge_call_targets (:2016) treats two coalesced targets as one when
same_call_target (:2049) says callee == callee && activation == activation,
then joins their inputs COLUMN-WISE via merge_summary_input_vec (:2074,
current[slot] = union(current[slot], next)); rebuild_coalesced_call_emission
(:1159) re-mints from that blended vector and contributes it as an
ActivationInputRow (:1245) beside the walked rows. That is the Cartesian
combination ActivationInputRow's own doc (semantic.rs:792-796) says the type
exists to make unrepresentable -- and it fires exactly when the callee key is
BLIND (two rows keying one activation), so the blend turns key blindness into
published evidence. Candidate C in the research (3 lines: stop contributing
the blend) measured 0 behaviour movers, 12 canon movers, executables +48,
and does not cure the false return fact by itself (repro183 then dies with
compiler2_unreachable_control) -- a correctness cleanup on its own terms.
Sequence AFTER fz-kdt.183's key fix (fewer blind keys => fewer blends to
delete; measure the executable delta then).

## Revised ordering

This is the exact-evidence prerequisite of fz-kdt.200. Remove the fabricated blended row through the production publication boundary before activation identity treats ActivationInputs as authoritative. The implementation must use the accepted PR #122 code containing fz-kdt.183 and must not add a compensating evidence store.

## Accepted boundary

- Commit: `dddfc460fc59b19bd8947c334a0b433cdb399a8b`, the second accepted ticket commit in draft PR #125 / stack #126.
- Exact full candidate SHA-256, including the measurement report: `cef0aaa658d1e81193fe5127004affef24afe4169a830c77e2fb51f933a0f6d0`; 11 files, 208 additions, 238 deletions.
- The focused production-boundary test was independently red on parent `55cec21ffc34c47aa52d6d50237f4cf696a358c0`: one fabricated blended sink row was published where two real correlated rows were required. It is green after deleting the whole rebuild pass and its sole helper.
- Full local gate: 1,971 library tests passed / 6 existing ignored, 642 serial fixture-matrix cases, 30 CLI cases, workspace all-target/all-feature check, strict Clippy, formatting, and diff checks.
- Fresh-process A/B evidence is retained in `.agent/measurements/fz-kdt.188-correlated-call-inputs.md`. Quicksort is byte/count identical; take/drop performs 22 fewer formula evaluations; predicate retains four additional precise executables. The predicate's unexplained product retries rise 25 -> 33 and remain unblessed residue owned by `fz-tfn.47`.
- A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review approved the exact candidate without findings and independently reproduced the red test.

No evidence store, retry exception, activation-key policy, or migration scaffolding remains from this cut.
